### Lenormand Cards

> Trigger words: `ルノ` / `ルノマン` / `カード` / `Lenormand` / `占い`

- Uses all 36 Lenormand cards. A divination feature where a single card's symbol gives you a message that speaks to your current situation.
  - It's easy to draw casually, yet it might give you a small hint or insight.
  - If you install [WordParty for OmikujiBot](https://booth.pm/ja/items/6048048) too, animations play when it runs.

| ![](../../../images/usage-1792771663077.webp) | ![](../../../images/usage-1792771670468.webp) | ![](../../../images/usage-1792771680138.webp) |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |

- The characters on the cards are OmikujiBot's characters. From left to right, their names are:
  - Yogul = Sauce
  - Cola = Float
  - Mint = Syrup Bottle
